title: APP Shield Day 8 actual demo scenario validation
environment: synthetic, in-process FastAPI simulator; no external payment processing
criteria_notice: Pass/fail checks broad expected behaviors listed per case; they are not hidden fraud labels or calibrated performance metrics.

scenarios.title: Normal friend payment
scenarios.expected_general_behavior: No severe action for the normal friend-payment scenario.

intervention.title: Verify this payment before continuing
intervention.message: We detected unusual circumstances around this payment. Please verify the recipient independently before continuing.
intervention.recommended_action: Contact the person or organization using a trusted contact method you found yourself.

scenarios.title: Legitimate large purchase
scenarios.expected_general_behavior: A high amount is assessed with recipient and context evidence; never complete on its own.

intervention.title: Verify this payment before continuing
intervention.message: We detected unusual circumstances around this payment. Please verify the recipient independently before continuing.
intervention.recommended_action: Contact the person or organization using a trusted contact method you found yourself.

scenarios.title: Established merchant
scenarios.expected_general_behavior: An established merchant is not blocked on fan-in or volume alone.

intervention.title: No additional check needed
intervention.message: No additional payment warning is indicated from the information provided.
intervention.recommended_action: Continue only if the payment details are correct.

scenarios.title: Government impersonation — flagship
scenarios.expected_general_behavior: Government-authority and manipulation evidence is assessed before simulated completion.

intervention.title: Verify this official request independently
intervention.message: Someone claiming to represent a government or law-enforcement office appears to be requesting this payment. Government agencies should not ask you to move money to a “safe account” to avoid an investigation.
intervention.recommended_action: Pause and contact the agency using contact details from its official website or a document you already trust.

scenarios.title: Bank impersonation
scenarios.expected_general_behavior: Bank-authority and transfer-request evidence is assessed before simulated completion.

intervention.title: Check this bank request through a trusted channel
intervention.message: This request has indicators associated with bank impersonation. Your bank should not ask you to transfer funds to protect or verify your account.
intervention.recommended_action: Do not use the caller’s number or link. Contact your bank using the number on your card or official app.

scenarios.title: Investment pressure
scenarios.expected_general_behavior: Investment, promised-return and pressure evidence is assessed.

intervention.title: No additional check needed
intervention.message: No additional payment warning is indicated from the information provided.
intervention.recommended_action: Continue only if the payment details are correct.

scenarios.title: Fake job fee
scenarios.expected_general_behavior: Job-fee and recruiter context are assessed.

intervention.title: Verify the employer before paying a fee
intervention.message: This payment appears connected to a job opportunity that may request an upfront fee.
intervention.recommended_action: Contact the employer through a separately verified channel before paying registration, training or onboarding fees.

scenarios.title: Tech support pressure
scenarios.expected_general_behavior: Remote-access and payment-request evidence are assessed.

intervention.title: Verify this technical-support request independently
intervention.message: This payment is connected to a request from someone claiming to provide technical support. Be cautious if they asked you to install remote access and transfer money to secure an account.
intervention.recommended_action: End the remote session and contact the company using support details from its official website or app.

scenarios.title: Family emergency request
scenarios.expected_general_behavior: Emergency context is assessed without trusting the story by itself.

intervention.title: Verify this payment before continuing
intervention.message: We detected unusual circumstances around this payment. Please verify the recipient independently before continuing.
intervention.recommended_action: Contact the person or organization using a trusted contact method you found yourself.

scenarios.title: Small initial investment scam
scenarios.expected_general_behavior: The small payment is analyzed with investment and reward/urgency context.

intervention.title: Check the investment before sending money
intervention.message: This payment has indicators commonly associated with investment scams, such as promised returns or pressure to act quickly.
intervention.recommended_action: Verify the provider and recipient independently. Guaranteed returns are a warning sign.

scenarios.title: Recipient network review
scenarios.expected_general_behavior: Recipient/graph availability is reported for analyst inspection without disclosing training labels.

intervention.title: No additional check needed
intervention.message: No additional payment warning is indicated from the information provided.
intervention.recommended_action: Continue only if the payment details are correct.

scenarios.title: Hinglish bank impersonation
scenarios.expected_general_behavior: The Hinglish message is evaluated by actual scenario and psychology services.

intervention.title: Check this bank request through a trusted channel
intervention.message: This request has indicators associated with bank impersonation. Your bank should not ask you to transfer funds to protect or verify your account.
intervention.recommended_action: Do not use the caller’s number or link. Contact your bank using the number on your card or official app.

scenarios.title: New recipient, context not provided
scenarios.expected_general_behavior: The flow asks for context or explicitly records the absent evidence before completion.
